test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements

**Statements**:

All computers are laptops.

Some laptops are mobiles.

**Conclusions**:

I. Some computers are mobiles.

 II. Some mobiles are computers.

III. Some mobiles are laptops.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusion I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e27f6b81ed370b1aad3283d6ecf73f0ad7ede7cc0399fa6f443d4e0df5cf082.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some computers are mobiles → False (it is possible but not definite)

 II. Some mobiles are computers → False (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some mobiles are laptops → True (As Some laptops are mobiles so, Some mobiles are laptops is true)

∴ Here, Conclusion III is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**
